        'format': 'tar+gzip',
        'bundle_b64': bundle_b64,
        'sha256': sha256
    }
    
    return json.dumps(result)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    # Read from stdin
    stdin_data = sys.stdin.read()
    
    # Process
    output = process_request(stdin_data)
    
    # Write to stdout
    sys.stdout.write(output)
    sys.stdout.flush()
